items.title: I can now confirm that Jock Landale did, in fact, waive his implied no-trade clause.
items.author: Brad Rowland
items.body_excerpt:
I can now confirm that Jock Landale did, in fact, waive his implied no-trade clause.

As noted here, I would’ve been quite surprised if he didn’t, but now official.
